title: Australian Chicken Casserole
description: A delicious Indian-inspired casserole made with tender chicken and aromatic spices.
instructions: Season the chicken with salt, pepper, and garam masala. Heat oil in a pan over medium heat and sear the chicken until browned.
Transfer the chicken to a 9x13 inch baking dish and set aside.
Add the chicken casserole mix to the pan and cook until lightly toasted.
Pour the casserole mix over the chicken and cover with foil.
Bake for 35-40 minutes or until the chicken is cooked through and the casserole is hot and bubbly.
Remove the foil and bake for an additional 5-10 minutes to brown the top.
